name: awg_metric_convert: Uses the geometric AWG definition, so results are exact for solid roun
description: Uses the geometric AWG definition, so results are exact for solid round conductors. Mass per metre and resistance follow from the material density and resistivity at 20 degrees Celsius; stranded conductors carry roughly two to five percent more mass and resistance per metre than the same nominal size and are not modelled separately. Supply either awg or cross_section_mm2, not both. Sizes 4/0 through 40 AWG are covered.
